# raff_vm_networks (Data Source)

Lists the network interfaces attached to a Raff VM. Returns one entry per NIC with stable MAC, IP, gateway, and security-group binding.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) VM UUID to look up network interfaces for.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Filter by interface type: `public`, `vpc`, or `ipv6`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `networks` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `mac` (String)
- `network_name` (String)
- `nic_id` (Number)
- `security_group_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
